subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

Aphrodite vowed that Paris __would had__ the most beautiful woman as his wife.
solution:
The correct answer is "**would have**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence the usage of the auxiliary verb "had" after the modal verb would is incorrect.
 
• We commonly use the "would have" as it is the** conditional perfect.**
 
• We use the modal auxiliary **would have** to refer to a situation to express a missed opportunity in the past.

**The correct sentence is**: *Aphrodite vowed that Paris would have__** the most beautiful woman as his wife*.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2**.
